Name: Mega Sol
Effect: This Pokémon gets all the beneficial effects of Sunny Weather (Removed Charge on Moves, Basic Heal becoming Complete Heal, Reduced Water-Type Damage, using Moves at night etc.) without the need of Sunny Weather being active.
Description: This Pokémon is a ray of sunshine in both the metaphorical and literal way. Their inner light can get them through the darkest moments.
